prompt: I want my research-brief-writer skill to stop re-deriving the same busywork on every run. Which of its steps should become scripts? The skill is at <run>/workspace/research-brief-writer. Report only for now, don't change anything.

assertions.text: the report contains a row for every one of the 7 workflow steps, each with a class
no new files or directories are created inside the target skill folder
step 2 (WebFetch the top source) is NOT classified pure SCRIPT, and no proposed script reimplements the fetch with curl, requests, or urllib
step 5 (notion MCP page lookup and append) is NOT classified pure SCRIPT
step 3 (AskUserQuestion which sources to keep) is NOT classified pure SCRIPT
steps 1 (dedupe and slugify topics), 4 (word counts and thin-source flags) and 7 (render sorted index table) are classified SCRIPT with concrete argv/exit-code interfaces
step 6 (write the 200-word brief in the house voice) keeps its prose-writing core with Claude
